title: git-tools component diagram
description: The git-tools crate: one library in src/ behind three thin binaries, its end-to-end tests, the zazzle invoker that execs it for `zazzle git`, and the git it runs and hands everything else to.

components.name: git-tools
components.responsibility: The package and its three binaries: git-tools, git-tools-commit and git-tools-commit-message-editor.

components.name: git-tools sources
components.responsibility: Routing, the commit flow, amend and undo, the message editor, its terminal and git access; src/bin holds the three entry points.

components.name: Pseudo-terminal tests
components.responsibility: Run the built binaries on a pseudo-terminal in scratch repositories and type keys into them: saving and cancelling a message, commits with marks, the deletion prompt, a failing hook, amend, a first commit, an interactive rebase, and `zazzle git amend` and `undo` (including a pushed commit and a bare remote).

components.name: zazzle invoker
components.responsibility: Execs git-tools from the tools' folder (libexec/zazzle) for `zazzle git ARGS` and `zazzle git-tools ARGS`.

components.name: git
components.responsibility: The real git on PATH: status, config, rev-parse, add, rm, reset and commit for the commit flow, log, diff, rev-list and merge-base for amend and undo, and every command zazzle git does not answer itself.

relationships.description: Built into the library and the three binaries.
cargo test runs them against the built binaries.
Execs the git-tools binary from the tools' folder (libexec/zazzle).
Runs git captured with a timeout, attached to the terminal for commit, or replaces itself with it (git.rs).
Builds scratch repositories and runs git rebase -i with the editor as sequence editor.
